title: Looking for a quick, healthy, and vegan dinner?
summary: This Chickpea Tikka Masala has all the flavor and none of the dairy! ⁠ ⁠ Save this recipe for your next dinner, and tag a friend who loves curry!
steps: Add garlic and ginger, cumin, ground coriander, paprika and cayenne pepper, garam masala, chickpeas, coconut cream and diced tomato.
Stir and let it simmer for 25 minutes until it thickens up in the flavors marry.
Serve with rice and fresh cilantro.
